tasks.subject: Task 1: Schema — webhook fields + ProcessedWebhook model
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the columns and model the rest of this plan depends on.

**Files:**
- Modify: `prisma/schema.prisma`
- Modify: `prisma/schema.production.prisma`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `ShopifyConnection.shopDomain` is `@unique`
- [ ] `ShopifyConnection` has `encryptedApiSecret String` and `webhookIds String`
- [ ] `WooCommerceConnection` has `encryptedWebhookSecret String` and `webhookIds String`
- [ ] New `ProcessedWebhook` model exists with a unique `deliveryId`
- [ ] Both schema files stay in sync

**Verify:** `npx prisma db push && npx prisma generate` → no errors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["prisma/schema.prisma", "prisma/schema.production.prisma"], "verifyCommand": "npx prisma db push && npx prisma generate", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ShopifyConnection.shopDomain is unique", "ShopifyConnection has encryptedApiSecret and webhookIds", "WooCommerceConnection has encryptedWebhookSecret and webhookIds", "ProcessedWebhook model exists with unique deliveryId"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Webhook delivery dedup helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A small, testable helper both webhook receivers use to avoid double-processing a redelivered webhook.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/webhooks/dedupe.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/webhooks/dedupe.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `wasAlreadyProcessed(prisma, deliveryId)` returns `false` and records on first call, `true` on repeat
- [ ] Uses ProcessedWebhook.deliveryId's unique constraint (catches P2002) rather than read-then-write

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/lib/webhooks/dedupe.test.ts` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/webhooks/dedupe.ts", "src/lib/webhooks/dedupe.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- src/lib/webhooks/dedupe.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["wasAlreadyProcessed returns false then true on repeat deliveryId", "catches P2002 unique constraint errors", "propagates other errors"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: HMAC verification helpers (Shopify + WooCommerce) + WC secret generator
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure, testable functions to verify an inbound webhook's signature for each platform, plus the generator Zorin uses to create its own WooCommerce webhook secret.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/shopify/webhookAuth.ts` + test
- Create: `src/lib/woocommerce/webhookAuth.ts` + test

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `verifyShopifyWebhook(rawBody, signatureHeader, apiSecret)` timing-safe HMAC-SHA256/base64 compare
- [ ] `verifyWooWebhook(rawBody, signatureHeader, webhookSecret)` same shape
- [ ] `generateWooWebhookSecret()` returns 64-char hex
- [ ] timingSafeEqual used, not ===

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/lib/shopify/webhookAuth.test.ts src/lib/woocommerce/webhookAuth.test.ts` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/shopify/webhookAuth.ts", "src/lib/shopify/webhookAuth.test.ts", "src/lib/woocommerce/webhookAuth.ts", "src/lib/woocommerce/webhookAuth.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- src/lib/shopify/webhookAuth.test.ts src/lib/woocommerce/webhookAuth.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["valid signature verifies true", "wrong secret or tampered body verifies false", "timing-safe compare used", "generateWooWebhookSecret returns 64-char hex"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Shopify connect/disconnect/status wiring + UI
tasks.description:

- Modify: `src/app/api/shopify/status/route.ts`
- Modify: `src/components/ShopifyConnectionCard.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Connect form requires `apiSecret`
- [ ] On connect, registers products/update, orders/create, app/uninstalled webhooks; persists encryptedApiSecret + webhookIds
- [ ] Disconnect best-effort deletes each registered webhook first
- [ ] status returns webhooksActive
- [ ] UI has apiSecret field and live-sync badge

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/app/api/shopify` → all pass

tasks.subject: Task 8: Shopify webhook receiver route
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The endpoint Shopify actually calls — verify, dedupe, sync.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/api/webhooks/shopify/route.ts`
- Test: `src/app/api/webhooks/shopify/route.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Invalid/missing HMAC → 401
- [ ] Unknown shopDomain → 404
- [ ] Replayed delivery id → 200, no reprocessing
- [ ] products/update → syncProducts with mapped single-item array
- [ ] orders/create → syncOrders with single-item array
- [ ] app/uninstalled → deletes ShopifyConnection row
- [ ] Unrecognized topic → 200 no-op
- [ ] Rate limited, keyed by shopDomain → 429

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/app/api/webhooks/shopify/route.test.ts` → all pass (8 tests)

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/api/webhooks/shopify/route.ts", "src/app/api/webhooks/shopify/route.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- src/app/api/webhooks/shopify/route.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["401 on bad signature", "404 on unknown shop domain", "200 no-op on replayed delivery id", "syncProducts/syncOrders called correctly per topic", "app/uninstalled deletes connection", "429 when rate limited"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
